added.title: Director, Engineering and Research
added.description:
Job Description:

Rakuten Group, Inc.
(TSE: 4755) is a global technology leader in services that empower individuals, communities, businesses, and society. Founded in Tokyo in 1997 as an online marketplace, Rakuten has expanded to offer services in e-commerce, fintech, digital content and communications to 2 billion members around the world. The Rakuten Group has around 30,000 employees, and operations in 30 countries and regions. For more information visit https://global.rakuten.com/corp/.

Job Summary:

Rakuten Americas’ AI & Data Division (AIDD) is seeking a passionate and experienced Director, Engineering and Research to play a pivotal role in bridging cutting-edge research with robust engineering capabilities to solve critical business needs. AIDD’s mission is to build world-class AI experiences that serve as the digital core of Rakuten’s global ecosystem.

In this role, you will focus on AI applications such as agent experiences, search, recommendation, personalization, and the broader customer experience—delivering meaningful impact for nearly 2 billion Rakuten users. Inspired by our CEO’s vision, “No AI, No Rakuten,” you will help ensure AI is embedded at the heart of everything we do.

You will define and execute multi-year technical and research roadmaps that align foundational research with real-world engineering execution. You will lead interdisciplinary teams, scale operations, and oversee the full lifecycle of innovation—from early-stage prototypes to production-ready, large-scale systems. The role requires close collaboration with executive stakeholders across Research, Product, Business, and global Rakuten teams to drive integrated, high-impact AI initiatives.

Key Responsibilities:

Strategic Leadership & Interdisciplinary Vision

Define and drive multi-year technical and research roadmaps, ensuring seamless integration of scientific discovery with scalable engineering implementation.
Champion a culture of deep collaboration between research and engineering, breaking down silos to accelerate innovation and solution delivery.
Guide architectural direction, modern engineering practices, and the adoption of technologies emerging from internal and external research.
Provide expert leadership on the transition from research prototypes to reliable, secure, production-grade systems.
Establish cross-functional standards and processes that support both research excellence and engineering efficiency.

Organizational & People Management

Build, mentor, and scale high-performing interdisciplinary teams, including both ICs and managers.
Lead talent strategies—recruitment, retention, performance management, and career development—for a diverse, technically excellent organization.
Communicate vision, goals, and priorities across functions, ensuring strong alignment and shared ownership.
Optimize resource allocation across multiple product lines and initiatives, balancing delivery velocity with long-term innovation.
Accountable for resource planning and budgetary oversight.

Cross-functional Collaboration & Business Impact

Partner with executive stakeholders in Research, Product, Business, and Operations to align on technical direction and deliver integrated solutions.
Drive cross-functional initiatives by uniting research and engineering contributions toward shared business goals.
Serve as a technical and scientific ambassador internally and externally, representing the team’s innovation and capabilities.
Identify and support strategic partnerships and business development opportunities that leverage the team’s research-engineering synergy.

Qualifications

To perform this job successfully, an individual must demonstrate excellence across the following domains. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Exceptional leadership in defining, communicating, and executing multi-year technical and research roadmaps for complex, large-scale systems.
Proven track record of building, coaching, and scaling interdisciplinary engineering and research organizations that deliver innovative, research-informed software products.
Deep expertise in architecting and operating scalable, secure, and resilient cloud-native systems, combined with a strong foundation in research methodology and experimental design.
Mastery of the full software development lifecycle, modern DevOps practices, and a commitment to engineering quality and scientific rigor.
Demonstrated ability to align and influence executive stakeholders across Research, Product, Business, and Operations on strategic, cross-functional initiatives.
Strong technical acumen in AI/ML domains, including LLMs, NLP, search, recommendation systems, and conversational AI.
Comfortable leading through ambiguity in fast-moving, international environments, managing globally distributed teams.
Outstanding communication and interpersonal skills; ability to translate complex technical and scientific concepts across diverse stakeholders.
Proven ability to attract, develop, and retain top-tier engineering and research talent, fostering a culture of innovation, psychological safety, and continuous learning.
Experience or strong potential for engaging in strategic partnerships and business development initiatives.
Fluency in English is required; proficiency in Japanese is a plus.

Minimum Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. Master’s or Ph.D. preferred. A Ph.D. in a relevant AI/ML research field (e.g., Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Statistics, Operations Research) is highly desirable.
12+ years of progressive experience in software engineering and/or applied research, including 5+ years in senior manager or director-level leadership roles.
Significant hands-on experience with large-scale, distributed systems and modern cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, GCP, Azure).
Proven ability to translate AI/ML research advancements—including Deep Learning, NLP, LLMs, and conversational AI—into scalable production systems.
Demonstrated success in leading large, interdisciplinary teams toward high-impact outcomes that combine research excellence with engineering precision.

Five Principles for Success

Our worldwide practices describe specific behaviors that make Rakuten unique and united across the world. We expect Rakuten employees to model these 5 Shugi Principles of Success.

Always improve, Always Advance
- Only be satisfied with complete success - Kaizen

Passionately Professional
- Take an uncompromising approach to your work and be determined to be the best

Hypothesize - Practice - Validate – Shikumika
- Use the Rakuten Cycle to succeed in unknown territory

Maximize Customer Satisfaction
- The greatest satisfaction for our teams is seeing their customers smile

Speed!! Speed!! Speed!!
- Always be conscious of time - take charge, set clear goals, and engage your team

Rakuten provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type. Rakuten considers applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetic information, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, provincial or local laws.

added.title: Director, Engineering - Platform
added.description:
What We Do:

Cybercrime is growing, and more businesses are getting hit by threats that used to target only the biggest organizations. That pushes defenders like us to operate at the highest level, and it deepens our need for good people who want to make a meaningful impact.

Founded in 2015 by former NSA cyber operators, Huntress is a remote-first team working to make enterprise-grade cybersecurity accessible to businesses of all sizes. We work closely with security teams and service providers protecting complex environments, often without the time or headcount to handle it all. That’s why we build our technology in-house and back it with a 24/7 human-led Security Operations Center (SOC). As a result, our platform is never disconnected from the experts who manage it, ensuring our customers' protection.

Huntress now secures more than 5M endpoints and 16M identities worldwide. Those numbers keep growing because more businesses rely on us to help carry the load and operate with more confidence. Every day, you can see that commitment in how we stand with our customers and how we show up for each other.

Reports to: Vice President, Engineering

Location: Remote US

Compensation: $240,000 to $300,000 base with bonus and equity

What You’ll Do:

Huntress seeks an experienced leader to elevate our platform engineering teams and deliver the underlying foundation for purpose-built products that protect the 99%. In this role, you’ll be responsible for teams that develop our product platform, which powers our 5 (soon to be 6 and beyond) industry-leading security products. We’re seeking a passionate, inclusive engineering leader who can bring state-of-the-art engineering practices and deep experience in developing teams and people to accelerate our next growth phase. You will lead multiple teams of high-performing engineers, equipped with the latest AI tooling.

At Huntress, we work with low walls between disciplines because we believe good ideas are everywhere and the best products come from teams working to deeply understand our customers, experiment, and validate our products.

Responsibilities:

Deliver performant, scalable products iteratively, helping your teams balance incremental customer value delivery with long-term product evolution
Drive the technical roadmap and best practices for our product platform to enable scalability that will accommodate rapid growth and increased user demand
Innovate new uses for AI development tooling and tune current use to be more efficient over time
Attract, recruit, and retain top engineering talent
Hire and coach engineering managers to continue to build and enable great teams
Set clear expectations with your leaders, provide regular feedback, and conduct regular performance conversations to foster a high-performing engineering team
Clearly measure engineering performance to make necessary adjustments to team structure and/or processes to increase throughput and efficiency
Identify opportunities and implement improvements to both the product and engineering practices and processes to optimize efficiency, quality, and time-to-market
Partner with other engineering leaders, product leaders, and architects to ensure our teams and technology are in sync and meet customer needs
Collaborate with Huntress’s Architecture, Product Management, and Threat Operations teams to integrate their expertise and needs into our products

What You Bring To The Team:

10+ years of experience in engineering leadership building SaaS products in a modern SaaS environment
5+ years of experience at the director level or higher
Hands-on experience with Claude Code or similar AI development tools
Experience and knowledge of best practices for scalable delivery, core platform systems, site reliability engineering, and developer experience
Experience developing, evolving, and maintaining high-volume, scalable solutions
Deep understanding of organizing engineering teams to deliver customer value iteratively
Skilled at hiring, building teams, leading, and coaching managers, and performance management
Demonstrated success working with architecture and product management leaders to develop and execute a shared product and technical vision
Experience in a fully remote environment

What We Offer:

100% remote work environment - since our founding in 2015
Generous paid time off policy, including vacation, sick time, and paid holidays
12 weeks of paid parental leave
Highly competitive and comprehensive medical, dental, and vision benefits plans
401(k) with a 5% contribution regardless of employee contribution
Life and Disability insurance plans
Stock options for all full-time employees
One-time $500 reimbursement for building/upgrading home office
Annual allowance for education and professional development assistance
$75 USD/month digital reimbursement
Access to the BetterUp platform for coaching, personal, and professional growth

Huntress is committed to creating a culture of inclusivity where every single member of our team is valued, has a voice, and is empowered to come to work every day just as they are.

We do not discriminate based on race, ethnicity, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, veteran status, genetic information, marital status, or any other legally protected status.

We do discriminate against hackers who try to exploit businesses of all sizes.

Coupa makes margins multiply through its community-generated AI and industry-leading total spend management platform for businesses large and small. Coupa AI is informed by trillions of dollars of direct and indirect spend data across a global network of 10M+ buyers and suppliers. We empower you with the ability to predict, prescribe, and automate smarter, more profitable business decisions to improve operating margins.

Why join Coupa?

Pioneering Technology: At Coupa, we're at the forefront of innovation, leveraging the latest technology to empower our customers with greater efficiency and visibility in their spend
Collaborative Culture: We value collaboration and teamwork, and our culture is driven by transparency, openness, and a shared commitment to excellence
Global Impact: Join a company where your work has a global, measurable impact on our clients, the business, and each other.

Learn more on Life at Coupa blog and hear from our employees about their experiences working at Coupa.

The Impact of a Sr. Director, AI Platform Engineering at Coupa:

Coupa's AI platform already powers conversational and autonomous agents, frontier model integrations, production ML models, and customer-facing AI experiences through Navi and Agent Studio. The Sr. Director, AI Platform Engineering will lead the next phase of this platform, expanding our model training capabilities, deepening our data infrastructure, and scaling our AI-powered features across the full breadth of Coupa's enterprise suite. You will build and lead a team of engineers across the US and India, manage strategic technology partnerships, and deliver measurable improvements to model accuracy, efficiency, and coverage. This role reports to senior engineering leadership with regular visibility to C-level stakeholders.

What You'll Do:

Lead the technical strategy and delivery roadmap for expanding Coupa's AI platform capabilities
Build and manage a high-performing engineering team across the US and India, hiring across ML, data engineering, and platform disciplines
Drive strategic partnership evaluations with AI infrastructure and model providers
Define and prioritize AI use cases that deliver the highest accuracy and business impact, working closely with product leadership
Expand model training, evaluation, and serving infrastructure beyond frontier model integrations
Own data strategy for AI, ensuring the right data pipelines, quality frameworks, and privacy-safe practices feed model development
Coordinate with existing AI platform, data platform, application platform, and cloud operations teams
Manage budget, hiring plan, and delivery milestones for the AI platform engineering organization
Present strategy, progress, and results to VP/SVP/C-level stakeholders
Ensure data safety, tenant isolation, and responsible AI practices across all AI capabilities

What You Will Bring to Coupa:

15+ years of software engineering experience, with 5+ years in engineering leadership (Director or Sr. Director level)
Track record building and leading AI/ML engineering teams of 15+ people across multiple geographies
Deep technical understanding of ML/AI systems, including model training, fine-tuning, RAG, and model serving. Must be able to evaluate technical decisions and challenge architects
Experience delivering AI/ML products in an enterprise B2B SaaS environment
Experience scaling engineering teams and shipping complex AI capabilities from concept to production
Strong partnership and vendor management experience with major AI and cloud providers
Experience with cloud infrastructure at enterprise scale
Track record managing distributed teams across US and India
Excellent executive communication, translating technical strategy into business impact for C-level audiences
Understanding of data privacy, tenant isolation, and responsible AI practices
Advanced degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience

added.description:
At Cadence, we hire and develop leaders and innovators who want to make an impact on the world of technology.

Position Overview

The Director of System Engineering & Integration leads the definition, architecture, and execution of end-to-end system integration across silicon, hardware, firmware, network and software for complex emulator platforms.

This role owns the integration strategy, system bring-up, and verification required to deliver production-ready systems, while driving alignment across globally distributed, cross-functional teams.

Leadership & Organizational Excellence

Build and lead global engineering teams responsible for system integration and validation.
Drive execution excellence, organizational scaling, and talent development.
Foster strong collaboration across hardware, firmware, software, ASIC, and operations teams.

System Architecture & Integration Strategy

Define the system integration architecture and technical strategy across ASIC, hardware, firmware, FPGA, and system software.
Establish design-for-integration principles, interface contracts, and integration readiness criteria.
Guide cross-functional technical decisions across interconnects, embedded systems, and system infrastructure.

System Integration, Bring-up & Validation

Own end-to-end integration and bring-up of multi-subsystem platforms.
Define and drive system-level validation and verification strategies, including performance and stress testing.
Lead resolution of complex cross-layer issues across hardware and software.

Methodology, Tooling & Infrastructure

Establish scalable validation infrastructure, automation frameworks, and test environments.
Drive standardization and reuse of system-level test methodologies.

Execution & Product Delivery

Own system readiness from bring-up to production release, ensuring performance and reliability targets.
Partner with engineering and product leadership to ensure predictable delivery.

Qualifications

Deep expertise in system engineering across silicon, hardware, firmware, drivers, OS and software.
Experience in integrating and delivering complex multi-interface systems.
Knowledge of large computing rack system architecture.
Proven system-level debugging capability and complex system issue root cause resolutions.
Experience leading global, cross-functional engineering teams.
Deep experience with interconnect technologies like Ethernet, RoCE / UEC, DDRx, PCIe.

Education

BS degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related fieldwith a minimum of 12 years of experience OR MS with a minimum of 10 years of experience OR PhD with a minimum of 8 years of experience
Masters / advanced degree in related field preferred.

Preferred Skills

Communication infrastructures such as PCIe, Infiniband, and distributed Ethernet network setups.
Distro-independent full spectrum of Linux in kernel space and user space in both server and embedded system, including system administration.
Distributed computing with high-availability and scalability.
System virtualization and containerization and real-world applications.

Impact

Drives successful integration and delivery of complex emulator systems, ensuring seamless interaction across hardware, firmware, network, and software while shaping system engineering practices at scale.

As one of the top accounting firms in the country, our foundation is "people first." In the words of James Kaufman, "we prioritize our people, their development, and their well-being. Our values are translated into action every day."

Kaufman Rossin is a privately owned, independent public accounting firm, which means we are not beholden to outside investors or private equity influence. This independence allows us to prioritize long-term client relationships, maintain objectivity in our advisory approach, and make strategic decisions that benefit our people and clients, not external stakeholders. Our structure fosters agility, entrepreneurial thinking, and a collaborative culture where leadership is accessible, and innovation is encouraged.

Celebrated as the Best Place to Work in South Florida over a dozen times, Kaufman Rossin has grown to over 700 employees, with offices spanning the tri-county area, including sister entities Kaufman Rossin Wealth and Kaufman Rossin Alternative Investment Services.

Think you have what it takes?

Define the technical roadmap for cloud platforms, DevOps, Kubernetes, infrastructure as code, and AI assisted engineering tools

Automation and Application Integration

Define build, buy, and platform strategies that improve efficiency, scalability, and return on investment
Establish standards for application integration, automation governance, and solution delivery

M Files Document Management

Lead the technical implementation and ongoing development of M Files, including architecture, configuration, and integration with Salesforce and Azure
Ensure the platform supports the document management, audit, security, and compliance requirements of a CPA firm

Vendor and Stakeholder Management

Manage strategic relationships with Microsoft, Salesforce, AI providers, automation platforms, and other technology partners
Lead vendor evaluations, requests for proposals, proof of concept assessments, and technology recommendations
Collaborate closely with Infrastructure, Security, Data Insights, PMO, Operations, and business leaders
Communicate complex technical strategies clearly to executive, client, business, and technical audiences

15 or more years of progressive leadership experience across software development, cloud infrastructure, DevOps, and platform engineering. Deep expertise in Azure and AWS architecture, governance, cost management, DevOps, Kubernetes, and infrastructure as code using Terraform or Bicep
Proven leadership experience with AI and machine learning applications, including large language models, retrieval augmented generation, Azure Open AI, responsible AI, and model selection. About Invesco

As one of the world’s leading independent global investment firms, Invesco is dedicated to rethinking possibilities for our clients. By delivering the combined power of our distinctive investment management capabilities, we provide a wide range of investment strategies and vehicles to our clients around the world. If you're looking for challenging work, intelligent colleagues, and exposure across a global footprint, come explore your potential at Invesco.

What’s in it for you?

Our people are at the very core of our success. Invesco employees get more out of life through our comprehensive compensation and benefit offerings including:
Flexible paid time off
Hybrid work schedule
401(K) matching of 100% up to the first 6% with a discretionary supplemental contribution

Job Description

Director, Solutions & Custom Strategies Technology (Wealth, SMAs & Model Portfolios)

Your Team

The Solutions & Custom Strategies Technology team partners with Invesco’s wealth and asset management business to deliver scalable, flexible technology solutions supporting model portfolios, separately managed accounts (SMAs), and customized investment strategies. Invesco’s platform enables financial advisors and institutions to deliver personalized equity and fixed income solutions through custom model portfolios and SMAs tailored to client objectives, risk preferences, and tax considerations. These solutions leverage open architecture, advanced analytics, and centralized technology platforms to deliver scalable, client-centric investment outcomes. The technology organization supports this ecosystem through modern cloud, data, and AI capabilities that enable personalization at scale across the wealth management landscape.

Your Role

As Director, Solutions & Custom Strategies Technology, you will lead the technology domain supporting wealth platforms, model portfolios, and SMA capabilities across equities and fixed income. You will oversee both delivery and architecture for solutions that enable portfolio construction, customization, and distribution across advisors and platforms. This role requires strong expertise in wealth technology, including model portfolio ecosystems, SMA platforms, and advisor workflows. You will lead through subordinate managers while partnering with investment, distribution, and product teams to deliver scalable, data-driven solutions powered by Snowflake and AI.

You Will Be Responsible For:

Leading the end-to-end technology strategy and execution for model portfolios, SMAs, and custom investment solutions across the wealth channel
Managing and developing subordinate leaders and teams delivering advisor-facing and portfolio construction platforms
Enabling the delivery of custom model portfolios and SMA solutions, supporting personalized investment strategies across equities and fixed income
Driving the architecture of portfolio construction, model management, and distribution platforms integrated with advisor and custodian ecosystems
Building and scaling data platforms leveraging Snowflake to unify portfolio, client, market, and performance data across wealth workflows
Enabling advanced analytics, portfolio insights, and personalization through AI-driven capabilities (e.g., client personalization, portfolio optimization, and advisor insights)
Translating business strategy into scalable technology and data roadmaps supporting growth in managed accounts and model-based solutions
Partnering with product, distribution, and advisory teams to align technology capabilities with client needs and evolving wealth management trends
Ensuring strong governance, risk management, and regulatory compliance across managed accounts and advisory platforms
Driving integration with third-party platforms, including custodians, trading systems, and portfolio management tools

The Experience You Bring:

Extensive experience leading technology organizations within wealth management or asset management environments
Deep expertise in wealth technology platforms, including model portfolio systems, SMA platforms, and advisor workflows
Strong understanding of custom model portfolios and separately managed accounts (SMAs), including portfolio construction, customization, and tax-aware strategies
Experience supporting investment strategies across equities and fixed income, including multi-asset portfolio construction and asset allocation
Proven experience implementing Snowflake or similar cloud-based data platforms to support investment analytics, reporting, and personalization
Experience leveraging AI and advanced analytics to deliver client personalization, portfolio insights, or advisor productivity solutions
Strong understanding of portfolio modeling, asset allocation frameworks, and performance analytics
Proven ability to lead managers and senior engineers in a complex, global organization
Strong cloud engineering and architecture experience, including integration of front-, middle-, and back-office systems
Ability to influence senior stakeholders across investment, product, and distribution organizations

added.description:
NVIDIA's invention of the GPU in 1999 sparked the growth of the PC gaming market, redefined modern computer graphics, and revolutionized parallel computing. More recently, GPU deep learning ignited modern deep learning - the next era of computing - with the GPU acting as the brain of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can perceive and understand the world. BS, MS, or PhD in EE/CS or related field of education or equivalent experience.

Strong technical leadership in data center system architecture, server manageability, telemetry, health management, and reliability at scale.

Excellent communication skills, strong work ethic, sound judgment, and the ability to align teams through complex technical and business tradeoffs.
